pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 这是什么? ask? (1 mark)
   A. When is it?
   B. Where is it?
   C. Who is this?
   D. What is this?

2. Which Chinese word means "school"? (1 mark)
   A. 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì
   B. 学校 xuéxiào
   C. 昨天 zuótiān
   D. 去 qù

3. Which Chinese word means "bed"? (1 mark)
   A. 椅子 yǐzi
   B. 放 fàng
   C. 下面 xiàmiàn
   D. 床 chuáng

4. How many strokes does 米 have? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 6
   D. 7

5. Which tone mark is written in bàba? (1 mark)
   A. Two marks
   B. A mark on the last a
   C. No marks
   D. One mark, on the first a

6. What does 十二月十二号 mean? (1 mark)
   A. 2 October
   B. 10 December
   C. 12 December
   D. 12 January

7. Which pattern says what is in a room? (1 mark)
   A. 有 + place + thing
   B. Place + thing + 里
   C. Thing + 有 + 里 + place
   D. Place + 里 + 有 + thing

8. Which sentence means "The sun is very big."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天下雨。
   C. 太阳很大。
   D. 这是太阳。

9. What does 水果 (shuǐguǒ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Milk
   B. What
   C. Fruit (as a group)
   D. Drinks

10. Which Chinese word means "Saturday"? (1 mark)
   A. 八 bā
   B. 六 liù
   C. 星期六 xīngqīliù
   D. 休息 xiūxi

11. Which sentence means "There are five people in my family."? (1 mark)
   A. 我爱你。
   B. 那是我哥哥。
   C. 我家有五口人。
   D. 这是我姐姐。

12. Which word is pronounced niúròu? (1 mark)
   A. 晚饭
   B. 水果
   C. 牛肉
   D. 水

13. What does 手 (shǒu) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hand
   B. Shoulder
   C. Head
   D. Foot

14. Read the pinyin: péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. We cut the cake.
   B. When is your birthday?
   C. My friend gives me a gift.
   D. We sing.

15. Which sentence means "The television is on the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 客厅里有电视。
   B. 电视在客厅。
   C. 电视在桌子上。
   D. 椅子在桌子下。

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name one kind of extreme weather. Say what causes it and give one safety tip. (4 marks)

17. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my eyes to see." and "I use my ears to hear." (4 marks)

18. Give three tips for following spoken instructions well. (3 marks)

19. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." and "Today it rains." (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — What is this?
   什么 means what.

2. B — 学校 xuéxiào
   学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

3. D — 床 chuáng
   床 (chuáng) means bed.

4. C — 6
   米 has six strokes.

5. D — One mark, on the first a
   The second syllable is light, so it has no mark.

6. C — 12 December
   十二月 is December.

7. D — Place + 里 + 有 + thing
   For example 卧室里有床。

8. C — 太阳很大。
   太阳很大。 (tàiyáng hěn dà.) means "The sun is very big.".

9. C — Fruit (as a group)
   水果 (shuǐguǒ) means fruit (as a group).

10. C — 星期六 xīngqīliù
   星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

11. C — 我家有五口人。
   我家有五口人。 (wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.) means "There are five people in my family.".

12. C — 牛肉
   牛肉 is pronounced niúròu and means beef.

13. A — Hand
   手 (shǒu) means hand.

14. C — My friend gives me a gift.
   péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù. is 朋友送我礼物。, which means "My friend gives me a gift.".

15. C — 电视在桌子上。
   电视在桌子上。 (diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.) means "The television is on the table.".

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example a flood: it is caused by too much heavy rain. Stay away from fast rivers. (A drought is caused by too little rain. Save water.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the event, 1 mark for the cause, 2 marks for a safety tip with a reason.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: 我用眼睛看。 wǒ yòng yǎnjing kàn. 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen to the whole instruction; catch the key words; ask for a repeat if unsure; show the answer by pointing or drawing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each tip.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà. 今天下雨。 jīntiān xià yǔ.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.
